svg.text: Type errors: g = 8 misses combinations; g = 2 invents unreachable ghosts
Testing candidate g against Gcd(12, 8) = { g > 0 | 12ℤ + 8ℤ = gℤ } requires two-way set equality: 12ℤ + 8ℤ ⊆ gℤ and gℤ ⊆ 12ℤ + 8ℤ.
Every reachable combination 12x + 8y lands on a purple dot, and every purple dot has a witness (x, y).
Grid 8ℤ is TOO COARSE — fails inclusion 12ℤ + 8ℤ ⊆ 8ℤ (8 does not divide 12)
Counterexample witness: (x, y) = (1, 0) gives 12 ∈ 12ℤ+8ℤ, and (1, −1) gives 4 ∈ 12ℤ+8ℤ, but neither lies in 8ℤ!
Grid 2ℤ is TOO FINE — fails reachability 2ℤ ⊆ 12ℤ + 8ℤ (no x, y gives 12x + 8y = 2)
Although 2 divides 12 and 8, every combination 12x + 8y = 4(3x + 2y) is a multiple of 4 — leaving all odd multiples of 2 as unreachable ghosts!
